rule: Fill-path only. Stamp name= stays catalog official_field_key (TIN/branch). Unstamped leftover writer keys may be copied onto the existing cell-id name= when the freeze sheet has exactly one fillable under a printed caption that matches one leftover-unique fields.json key, and the identity catalog names that cell as html_id_hint. That is not an official_field_key harvest. Text joins ASCII-uppercase letters into comb slots and data-writer-value for BIR CAPITAL LETTERS print; digits and punctuation are unchanged. Do not mutate profile/DB values. R3 peso+cent tax rows may be listed in money_joins: one leftover money key maps to peso_html_id plus cent_html_id. Split the writer {:.2} string: pesos right-aligned in the peso comb (leading slots empty, not zero-padded, no decimal glyph), cents in the 2-slot comb. Do not stamp name= on either comb. Do not left-align the dotted string into the peso comb. Leftover boolean/radio keys may be listed in xbox_joins: when the writer is true, put X in the catalog xbox (1-char text, not type=checkbox). Do not write the string true into the box. Do not join collapsed writer txt25-28, or leftover keys that share an item number with another leftover except as documented here (year-ended MM/YYYY pair; quarter radio group). Since #113: every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason; the earlier demo slices (Part II, Item 4, Items 12-13, overpayment, Schedule 1) are now joined by the same caption rule. One writer key may fill several cells (html_ids). Print-only derived: keys come from Form2551QDraft::to_print_field_map: the page-2 TIN comb, Item 9 over its two lines, Item 12A and the Schedule 1 ATC code and rate; Schedule 1 rows past the draft print blank.
